tasks.title: README and configuration describe the layout on console main
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console — Task items 1–4; all Required behavior (Overview, navigation/account row, Checks and other tables, token presets and forms); Checks 1–5; Counterexamples; Security impact; Completion evidence. Keep README short, link to configuration and the existing checks/tokens/team docs for detail, preserve the settings/endpoints tables and link-color sentence, and change only the two listed docs. Re-read current main; request a hold for a material source/runtime contradiction rather than changing code or documenting behavior that does not exist.

acceptance.command: git rev-parse origin/main; git show origin/main:src/overview.ts; git show origin/main:src/navigation.ts; git show origin/main:src/shell.ts; git show origin/main:src/styles.ts; git show origin/main:src/check-pages.ts; git show origin/main:src/check-filters.ts; git show origin/main:src/token-pages.ts; git show origin/main:src/token-view.ts; git show origin/main:src/probe-pages.ts; git show origin/main:src/team-pages.ts
acceptance.expected: Manually compare the current main sources to Required behavior before writing. The spec baseline is fc2c166de8237a841b5253cef99bb3fd17f85f2f. If main has advanced, re-read it and report harmless differences in the PR; a difference changing a required point's meaning requires a hold. The five filtered tile links, unfiltered Total, 719px breakpoint, navigation roles, four Checks columns, table scrolling, preset cards and form limits agree with the cited sources. No source file changes.

Before committing, exactly two lines: README.md
docs/configuration.md
Before committing, only README.md and docs/configuration.md are modified; zero untracked files. After committing, the working tree is clean.

On the final committed branch, exactly two lines: README.md
docs/configuration.md
On the final committed branch, exit 0 with no output.
Exit 0; no dependency or lockfile change.
Exit 0 for the full lint, typecheck and test gate, including the existing 80% line coverage threshold.

Sign in locally with the fixture account and manually compare the new docs with the running console at 1280px and 390px, plus a dark-scheme check. The sentence is 'Overall state: Down. At least one check is down.' The six tiles, in order, are Down 1 -> /checks?state=down, Degraded 1 -> /checks?state=degraded, Unknown 1 -> /checks?state=unknown, Maintenance 1 -> /checks?state=maintenance, Up 1 -> /checks?state=up, Total 5 -> /checks. Follow all six links: each state filter selects its named state; down has 1 row (db-port), degraded 1 (cert), unknown 4 (domain-exp, nightly-backup, db-port-db, dns-db), maintenance 1 (dns-a), up 1 (web), and unfiltered /checks has 9 rows (8 effective checks and shadowed DNS record (old)). These literals come from serve() calling replyChecks(env.api, []) in e2e/run.ts:2847-2850, replyChecks at :1308-1340 and test/check-fixtures.ts:69-76,96-102. Overview counts only the API /checks entries; the list also includes configured checks missing from that answer as Unknown and, when unfiltered, shadowed definitions. Unknown 1 versus 4 rows and Total 5 versus 9 rows are intentional differences, which configuration must explain; never require equal counts. No tile has count 0 in this fixture. At 390px, navigation is one horizontally scrolling row with icons, keyboard focus reveals an off-screen link, and Incidents is absent; the account row has no avatar, truncates long identity text with an ellipsis, and keeps role, Account security and Sign out visible. Checks has the visible hint 'Scroll sideways to see all columns.' and scrolls inside the named region at 390px; its headers at 1280px are Check, Target, State, Actions. /tokens/new has four cards in order Read, Manage checks, Post incidents, Full access, none initially checked, with the shared admin-access note above them. None is disabled here: the fixture console token has read, checks, incidents and admin (e2e/run.ts:1742-1747). /team has the 2FA header and On or Off labels, never Yes, No or a check mark. Fix inaccurate prose; if runtime counts differ, compare the named independent fixture sources. If main changed them, record the new literal expectations in the PR; otherwise hold for a spec/runtime contradiction. Do not change fixtures or code or publish fixture credentials.

acceptance.command: sed -n '46,102p' src/overview.ts; cat src/overview.test.ts; sed -n '2412,2426p' e2e/run.ts; sed -n '46,47p' src/token-pages.ts; sed -n '140,155p' src/token-pages.ts; sed -n '7,27p' src/token-view.ts; sed -n '98,104p' src/token-view.ts
acceptance.expected: Manual source/assertion review confirms that zero checks shows 'No checks yet' and 'Reload' without tiles; no-token, rejected-token and failed-read views also have no tiles. COUNT_ROWS maps all six entries without filtering zero counts on a nonempty successful read. The separate browser matrix uses its own six-entry answer and asserts Down 2, Degraded 1, Unknown 0, Maintenance 0, Up 3, Total 6 (e2e/run.ts:2412-2426); these are not the --serve fixture counts. bun run check:browser may optionally demonstrate this matrix without changing it. The docs include those exceptions and count API /checks entries, excluding shadowed definitions; configuration explains why missing API entries become Unknown list rows, so Unknown and Total can be smaller than their list row counts, while state filters exclude shadowed rows. Source review also confirms the disabled-preset exception not shown by --serve: a card missing a console-token scope stays visible, disabled, with 'The console token lacks <scope>.' naming the first missing scope in preset order. With held scopes read and admin, Read is enabled; Manage checks, Post incidents and Full access are disabled, naming checks, incidents and checks respectively. Preset scopes are exactly Read [read], Manage checks [read, checks, admin], Post incidents [read, incidents, admin], Full access [read, checks, incidents, admin]. None is selected on the initial form; the shared admin-access note applies to the latter three presets.

Manually review against Required behavior, every Counterexample and the cited main sources. README explains overall state, the five filtered tiles plus unfiltered Total, empty/failure exceptions, desktop sidebar and mobile navigation, and links to configuration. Configuration defines counts as entries of the API /checks answer and explains in one or two sentences why configured checks missing from it become Unknown list rows and why shadowed definitions increase the unfiltered list; it never promises equal tile and list counts. Configuration covers all tile exceptions; sticky desktop sidebar with its own scroll, mobile header/719px breakpoint, icons/focus/non-interactive chevron or fallback-shadow hints, screen-reader Instance heading and Signed in as prefix, role-visible entries and route authorization, and the desktop email wrapping/mobile ellipsis distinction. Reject a draft with six Checks columns or missing Actions: headers are Check, Target, State, Actions, with id/source under Check, type above Target, and last-result time under State except for shadowed rows. Reject page-wide scrolling or an always-visible hint: the table scrolls inside the named focusable Checks table region, and 'Scroll sideways to see all columns.' appears only at 719px or less. Reject claims that values are always fully visible or shortened to a fixed character count: long values can be clipped visually, while full values remain in markup/detail (the long-url fixture in e2e/run.ts:2357 uses https://example.com/ plus 100 p characters). Tokens/Probes retain headers and scroll inside their boxes. Reject Team Yes/No or empty action cells: 2FA uses On/Off and unavailable actions show a dash announced as No actions. Token cards have no initial selection, correct descriptions/scopes or a link to docs/tokens.md, the shared admin-access note and visible disabled cards naming their first missing scope; reject default Read selection, omitted admin scopes or hidden/unrestricted cards. Reject fixed field widths or full-form stretching: 40rem/12rem/24rem are maximums for normal/short/name-or-id fields, with narrow-screen fit; Copy buttons stay compact, require JavaScript, and recovery codes stay on one line. Relevant detail links to docs/checks.md, docs/tokens.md and docs/team.md work. No fixed grid-column guarantee or unrelated cleanup is introduced; the settings/endpoints tables and link-color sentence remain unchanged. All remaining counterexamples are false for the draft, and all named labels, links, breakpoints and scopes match the independently cited source.

acceptance.command: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- README.md docs/configuration.md; git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | sort
acceptance.expected: Final manual security and PR-evidence review: no secrets or fixture credentials in the docs or PR body; Security impact remains no, with only the two Markdown paths changed. The PR names issue #791, lists README.md and docs/configuration.md as the complete diff, records bun run check's result and the manual fixture command, widths (1280px/390px), dark-scheme observations, all six tile destinations, filter selections and literal tile/list counts (including Unknown 1 versus 4 rows and Total 5 versus 9 rows), navigation/account/table/preset/Team observations, and any known browser limitation such as static shadows without scroll-driven animations. Record source evidence for zero-count tiles and disabled presets separately because --serve does not demonstrate those cases. No code, tests, styles, dependencies, CSP, routes, roles or other docs change.
